system.description:
Clan Trait

Mutated Trait: Wood Release Affinity, Mokuton Release Techniques

Select one Nature release between Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, Lightning or Medical. You are now able to add jutsu with the corresponding Keyword to your jutsu list. (Suggestion: Water Release)

At 1st, 3rd, 7th, 11th, and 15th levels, you can add 2 jutsu you qualify for with the chosen keyword.

If you take this mutation, you must also take any one 1st, 3rd, 11th and 15th level Senju mutation.
